openapi: 3.1.0
info:

  title: Api
  version: 0.1.0
  description: Naylor Legal Matter Hub API
servers:
  - url: /api
    description: Base API path
tags:
  - name: health
  - name: session
  - name: staff
  - name: hr
  - name: matter-types
  - name: matters
  - name: tasks
  - name: aml
  - name: dashboard
  - name: audit

  - name: backups
paths:
  /healthz:
    get:
      operationId: healthCheck
      tags: [health]
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/HealthStatus"

  /me:
    get:
      operationId: getCurrentUser
      tags: [session]
      summary: Get the current authenticated staff member (JIT provisioned)
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Current user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CurrentUser"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
  /me/preferences:
    patch:
      operationId: updateMyPreferences
      tags: [session]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/PreferencesUpdate"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CurrentUser"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
  /me/profile:

  /staff:

      operationId: listStaff
      tags: [staff]

            application/json:

        "400":

        "404":

  /matters:

      operationId: listMatters
      tags: [matters]

          schema: { type: string }
        - name: matterTypeId
          in: query

        outcome: { type: string }
        note: { type: string }

info:

    get:
      operationId: healthCheck

      summary: Health check
      responses:
        "200":

          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/HealthStatus"

        "200":
          description: Current user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CurrentUser"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
  /me/preferences:
    patch:
      operationId: updateMyPreferences
      tags: [session]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/PreferencesUpdate"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CurrentUser"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"

            schema:

      responses:

components:
  parameters:
    IdParam:
      name: id
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: integer
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Bad request
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
    Unauthorized:
      description: Unauthorized
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
    Forbidden:
      description: Forbidden
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
    NotFound:
      description: Not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
  schemas:
    HealthStatus:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
      required:
        - status
    Error:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          type: string
      required:
        - error
    BackupFile:
      type: object
      required: [name, path, size, modifiedAt]
      properties:
        name: { type: string }
        path: { type: string }
        size: { type: integer }
        modifiedAt: { type: string }
    BackupStatus:
      type: object
      required: [backups, lastBackupAt, schedule]
      properties:
        backups:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/BackupFile"
        lastBackupAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        schedule: { type: string }
    BackupResult:
      type: object
      required: [fileName, path, size, totalRows, generatedAt]
      properties:
        fileName: { type: string }
        path: { type: string }
        size: { type: integer }
        totalRows: { type: integer }
        generatedAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    UpdateCount:
      type: object
      properties:
        updated:
          type: integer
      required:
        - updated

    CurrentUser:
      type: object
      required: [staffId, fullName, initials, email, role, department, status, emailOptIn]
      properties:
        staffId: { type: integer }
        fullName: { type: string }
        initials: { type: string }
        email: { type: string }
        role:
          type: string
          enum: [principal_admin, solicitor, paralegal, hr_admin, none]
        department:
          type: string
          enum: [legal, office]
        status: { type: string }
        jobTitle: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        photoUrl: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        emailOptIn: { type: boolean }
    PreferencesUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        emailOptIn: { type: boolean }
    MyProfileUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        fullName: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        initials: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 5 }
        jobTitle: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        photoUrl: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    StaffAccessUpdate:
      type: object
      required: [status]
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [active, suspended]
        role:
          type: string
          enum: [principal_admin, solicitor, paralegal, hr_admin, none]

    Staff:
      type: object
      required: [id, fullName, initials, email, role, department, status, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: integer }
        fullName: { type: string }
        initials: { type: string }
        email: { type: string }
        role:
          type: string
          enum: [principal_admin, solicitor, paralegal, hr_admin, none]
